reviewer: claude-sonnet-5 (delegated review; per Rochak Agarwal, rochak.ag779@gmail.com, 2026-09-04)
rationale: Destination is a Twitter/X share-intent URL from a social-share widget, not page content a citizen navigates to. x.com blocks non-browser/automated requests to /share, which is why this crawler's fetch fails — a human clicking the button in a real browser is not blocked. Not real evidence of a broken destination for the audited portal's audience. Rejected, not published.
